corpus.title: General Information
corpus.text:
General Information
Project name: Example Farm Soil Carbon. Developer: Example Soil Ltd. Country: Exampleland. Area under management 412 ha of arable and grassland.

corpus.title: Credit Class and Methodology
corpus.text:
Credit Class and Methodology
The project applies the Soil Organic Carbon Estimation methodology version 1.2.2, the latest published version, under the managed crop and grassland credit class.

corpus.title: Project Proponent and Owner
corpus.text:
Project Proponent and Owner
The proponent is Example Soil Ltd. The land owner is Example Farm Partnership, which holds freehold title to all parcels.

corpus.title: Project Ownership
corpus.text:
Project Ownership
Ownership of carbon rights rests with the land owner, evidenced by the land registry title and a signed agreement with the proponent.

corpus.title: Project Start Date
corpus.text:
Project Start Date
The project start date is 1 March 2025, the date regenerative practices began. Baseline soil sampling took place in autumn 2024.

corpus.title: Crediting Period
corpus.text:
Crediting Period
The crediting period is ten years, from 1 March 2025 to 28 February 2035.

corpus.title: Project Location
corpus.text:
Project Location
The gross project area is 412 ha across 31 fields. Field boundaries are supplied as shapefiles in WGS84.

corpus.title: Conditions Prior to Project Initiation
corpus.text:
Conditions Prior to Project Initiation
Satellite land cover maps show the land has been cropland or grassland for more than ten years; no natural ecosystems were converted.

corpus.title: No Net Harm
corpus.text:
No Net Harm
Practices will not harm biodiversity, water or neighbouring land. Hedgerows and field margins are retained.

corpus.title: Local Stakeholder Consultation
corpus.text:
Local Stakeholder Consultation
Neighbours and the parish council were informed in writing; no objections were received.

corpus.title: Project Boundary
corpus.text:
Project Boundary
GHG sources and sinks inside the boundary: soil organic carbon, fuel use, fertiliser and livestock emissions.

corpus.title: Leakage
corpus.text:
Leakage
Yield reduction leakage is assessed against national average yields; a deduction applies if yields fall more than 10%.

corpus.title: Risk Management
corpus.text:
Risk Management
A 10% buffer pool covers reversal risk over the permanence period.

corpus.title: Monitoring Plan
corpus.text:
Monitoring Plan
Soil cores are taken to 30 cm every three years, analysed by an accredited laboratory using dry combustion.

items.requirement: The project must apply the latest version of the methodology.
The project must demonstrate legal right to the land and carbon rights.
No conversion of natural ecosystems in the ten years before the start date.
The start date must be stated and justified.
The crediting period must be stated.
A soil sampling and laboratory analysis plan must be provided.
